# Monster kinds - design data: #   One row = one kind. SpawnRegion.csv and DropTable.csv point at a kind by monsterId.
#   monsterId : 1 or more (0 = none). The number is the array index - keep ids small.
#   maxHp / attack / defense : copied into the monster when it is born. damage = attack - defense (at least 1).

1..15. Above 15 the server refuses to start - the AI think interval assumes it (MonsterAI.h MAX_SPEED).

# Monster kinds - design data: #   exp     : given to the player who lands the last hit.
#   display : displayChar sent on the wire; clients pick the sprite by it. 1..15 (0x01..0x0F) = monster (Protocol.h).

0..4 (optional - a blank or missing cell is 0 = a point). Attack range is measured between body edges.

# Monster kinds - design data: #                The web sprite size (MON_META.scale in WebClient/assets/monsters.js) is a separate value - set the two together.
#   The first cell must be a number - GameDataCsv treats a line whose first cell is not a number as the header.
#   snake: maxHp 30 = 3 hits of a level-1 player (attack 10) / speed 5 = slower than players so they can run / exp 10 = level 2 needs 100
